fields.subject: ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg ArgentSeaGatewayListProvider
fields.response: runs the configured query, or Queries.OrleansClusterGatewayList (rdr.orleans_cluster_gateway_list_v1) when none is configured, with p_cluster_id set to the cluster id, and maps every [address bytes, proxy port, generation] row to a gateway URI in result order
fields.postcondition: a client receives the gateways of the cluster's active silos; a login holding only orleans_client can run it
